actions.description: Pipette with tip already attached moves into view toward tube rack.
Tip is inserted into a tube in the blue rack; likely aspirates liquid.
Pipette is withdrawn and moved from tube rack toward a multiwell plate/reservoir area.
Tip is positioned over/into wells and liquid is dispensed across several positions; no tip ejection visible.

reuse.evidence: Same tip is used from a source tube to dispense into wells, but no visible evidence of reuse on a different sample/reagent or after discard was required.

surface.evidence: Tip does not visibly touch bench, glove, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface before use.

release.evidence: Tip remains attached; no unexpected drop/ejection is visible.

install.evidence: Tip appears seated and appropriate on the pipette; no visible misfit.

output.overall_summary: Visible technique appears consistent with aspirating from a tube and dispensing into wells using an attached tip; no clear pipetting error is shown.
